detailed_description:
The target video uses realistic cinematic drama, warm low-key tungsten lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, natural facial micro-expressions, and restrained performances. The emotional rhythm is quiet and compressed, with brief but meaningful pauses. Dialogue is spoken in natural English with accurate lip synchronization.

[Shot 1] The camera begins outside the restaurant, looking through the reflective window at <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> seated opposite each other inside <Subject 1>. The medium two-shot follows the composition and atmosphere of <Picture 1>. Warm restaurant light illuminates their faces while passing headlights, streetlights, and moving reflections slide across the glass and briefly layer over their eyes. The camera slowly pushes closer through the window without crossing the glass. <Subject 2> keeps her face turned toward the street, refusing to look at the man. <Subject 3> remains silent for a brief beat, looks down, then finally raises his eyes toward her. <Subject 3> (S1) speaks softly, with hesitation and regret: <d>[English] I thought you were bluffing when you said you were leaving.</d> <Subject 2> does not turn toward him. After a short pause, <Subject 2> (S2) answers quietly and without visible anger: <d>[English] So you did nothing.</d> She closes her lips and continues looking through the window as another band of passing light moves across her face.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the video cuts to an intimate alternating close-up composition guided by <Picture 2>. <Subject 3> lifts his eyes toward <Subject 2>; his jaw is slightly tense and his expression briefly freezes as though he is struggling to explain himself. <Subject 3> (S1) says with restrained urgency, <d>[English] I wanted to ask you to stay. I thought we had time.</d> The camera cuts naturally to <Subject 2>, whose detailed facial identity, curls, earrings, and red lipstick match the left side of <Picture 2>. She finally turns away from the window and looks directly at him, holding his gaze for a brief silent beat. <Subject 2> (S2) replies in a calm, tired voice: <d>[English] You thought that after every fight.</d> Beneath the table, the hand resting on her lap slowly tightens into a restrained fist. Her expression remains composed, but her eyes reveal disappointment.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to a close side-angle two-shot across the table. <Subject 3> hesitantly reaches forward and gently touches <Subject 2>'s other hand resting near the table edge. She does not pull away immediately. They hold silent eye contact as the restaurant ambience and moving street reflections continue around them. His expression carries fragile hope, while hers gradually settles into quiet certainty. After a brief pause, she slowly withdraws her hand from beneath his fingers. <Subject 2> picks up her dark coat from the adjacent chair and begins to stand. Looking at him one final time, <Subject 2> (S2) says softly but decisively: <d>[English] We should break up.</d> She turns and walks out of frame carrying the coat. <Subject 3> remains seated and does not follow. The camera stays with him in a motionless medium shot as he watches her leave, his untouched hand still resting on the table. The final image holds on his silent, stunned expression through the reflective restaurant glass.

overall_soundscape:
Low nighttime restaurant room tone continues throughout, including faint cutlery sounds, subdued distant conversation, soft ventilation, muffled traffic, and occasional passing-car noise outside the window. Dialogue remains intimate and clearly audible. Physical sounds include quiet fabric movement, the slight touch and withdrawal of hands, the chair moving as the woman stands, and her fading footsteps. No subtitles or visible text.

non_diegetic_music:
A very restrained, melancholic score with sparse felt-piano notes and a low sustained cello tone plays quietly beneath the scene. It never swells dramatically and leaves space for the dialogue and final silence.
